operation_descriptors.description: Retrieve public TCGA GBM/LGG study and molecular-profile catalogue metadata; no patient, sample, or assay values.
Retrieve ClinicalTrials.gov glioma or glioblastoma registry metadata; no eligibility or treatment-benefit assessment.
Retrieve bounded Europe PMC bibliographic metadata for fixed neurosurgical lanes; no abstracts or full text.
Retrieve fixed TCGA-GBM and TCGA-LGG NCI GDC project summaries and aggregate availability; no patient or molecular values.
Reconcile separate public glioma citation, registry, and aggregate project metadata with explicit omissions; no scientific or clinical interpretation.
Produce a digest-bound glioma metadata review handoff with original citations, missing data, and explicit human review requirements.
Retrieve bounded GWAS Catalog association metadata for fixed direct glioblastoma/glioma traits; no causal or treatment inference.
Retrieve identity, aliases and concise metadata for twelve fixed human glioma-research gene markers; no variant interpretation.
Retrieve one bounded ranked association page for fixed glioblastoma or low-grade glioma disease IDs; scores are not causal or clinical confidence.
Retrieve fixed neurosurgical PubMed lanes with citation metadata and bounded abstracts. Glioma includes adult diffuse glioma and glioblastoma. Keywords are not exhaustive.
